occupation: Full Stack Developer Fellow at CUNY Tech Prep
headline: Software/Data Engineer | CUNY Tech Prep Full Stack Developer Fellow | Computer Science Student @City University of New York - College of Staten Island
summary:
"Technology is best when it brings people together." - Matt Mullenweg

I am a passionate and driven Full Stack Developer with a strong foundation in both front-end and back-end technologies. Currently, I am honing my skills in the CUNY Tech Prep Full Stack Development Fellowship program, where I am learning the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js) to build robust, scalable web applications.

Recently, I had the privilege of collaborating with Bloomberg engineers through their Tech Lab Fellow program. During this experience, I designed and implemented a powerful message queue system using RabbitMQ and Docker, significantly enhancing real-time data processing and communication between producer and consumer components. This project not only solidified my technical abilities but also provided me with valuable insights into financial domain concepts like tickers and industry sectors.

My core competencies include:
- Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, and related frameworks
- Expertise in designing and developing RESTful APIs
- Strong understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles
- Experience with Docker, RabbitMQ, and other modern development tools

I am enthusiastic about leveraging my skills to create innovative solutions that solve real-world problems. I am particularly interested in opportunities that allow me to work on cutting-edge technologies and collaborate with like-minded professionals who are equally passionate about technology.

Let's connect and explore how we can drive technological advancements together!
